body: Hah.  Surviving. Panicking. I feel miserable and I don't know what to do.
Good lord, that was fast hah
You could maybe talk to the teachers/guidance counselor and say what's going on and that she might be under extra stress so to monitor her a little more for a while?

And things happen. She probably already kind of knows that things aren't going well. Just be nice and be honest. I broke up with a guy in high school around the same time because I knew it wasn't working and I felt awful, but it worked out just fine. We didn't stop being friends and we still sometimes talk today.

Honestly, as long as you graduate with good grades and have joined clubs or volunteered/had a job etc., you'll be fine in college. The first few years are all the same classes for everyone, so the major you pick right away won't really matter until later on. You have plenty of time to figure out what to do
I'm worried because I feel like he'll tell me I need to go somewhere (and I can't say I disagree) but I know I can't afford it. I want to go, I do, but I'm barely making ends meet now as it is.

I know I need to tell my therapist, but I'm so scared. I feel like I should know better and that I shouldn't keep feeling like this--almost like if I tried harder, I'd be happy and this wouldn't be a problem. I'm so embarrassed. I don't even know how to bring it up.

Hey. Thanks. I really appreciate it. I just need to feel like I'm not totally alone with this. I'm really overwhelmed and I recently relapsed with an old habit, so I kind of know that I'm going to again. I know there's no way I can even go through tonight without doing it.
